class.name: BlueprintResource
class.brief_description: Serializable 2D architectural floorplan resource backing 3D extrusion and reactive walls.
class.description: Wraps [code]ArchitecturalBlueprintCore[/code] with full Godot resource serialization for [member spaces] and [member features]. Automatically generates exterior/interior wall segments, map-key annotations, and 3D structure layout summaries.

method.name: add_space_polygon
method.description: Adds a closed 2D room polygon in meters and synchronizes serialized space data.

method.name: add_feature_symbol
method.description: Adds a door, window, archway, stair, or fixture symbol and synchronizes serialized feature data.

method.name: populate_sample_room
method.description: Appends a 5m x 4m sample room polygon and rebuilds reactive wall layers.

method.name: clear_blueprint
method.description: Clears all spaces, walls, features, and serialized arrays.

method.name: rebuild_reactive_layers
method.description: Recomputes exterior/interior wall segments, apertures, and measurement annotations from the current spaces and features.

method.name: get_space_count
method.description: Returns the number of authored space polygons.

method.name: get_wall_count
method.description: Returns the number of generated wall segments.

method.name: get_feature_count
method.description: Returns the number of authored feature symbols.

method.name: get_annotation_count
method.description: Returns the number of measurement annotations.

method.name: extrude_to_3d_layout_summary
method.description: Extrudes the 2D blueprint into a 3D layout solver and returns node, socket, and cutout counts.

members.member: Horizontal architectural section cut plane elevation in meters (defaults to standard 4-foot / 1.2192m cut).
Serialized array of room space dictionaries persisted with the resource.
Serialized array of door, window, and fixture feature dictionaries persisted with the resource.
